seo.h1: M-340 Titanium Dioxide for Plastics and Masterbatch Evaluation

hero.summaryLead: A chloride-process rutile titanium dioxide pigment documented for high-concentration masterbatch, films, injection plastics and other plastics evaluation.
hero.summaryBody: M-340 uses inorganic and organic treatment and is documented with dispersibility, bluish undertone, whiteness, high-temperature anti-yellowing and stable film-production directions. Review the technical index below and confirm suitability through testing in your own formulation, processing and end-use conditions.

positioning.heading: Where M-340 Fits in Product Evaluation
positioning.lead: M-340 is a rutile titanium dioxide pigment produced by the chloride process for plastics evaluation.
positioning.body: Its documented public profile combines inorganic and organic treatment with approved application directions in high-concentration masterbatch, films, silk and wire plastics, injection plastics and moderate-durability plastics. Use M-340 as a candidate when dispersion, color direction, whiteness, heat exposure and production stability are relevant. Final Grade selection should account for resin, additive package, pigment loading, processing temperature, equipment, end-use conditions and destination-document requirements.
decisionPoints: Al₂O₃ inorganic treatment and organic treatment
Evaluation of dispersibility, bluish undertone, whiteness, high-temperature anti-yellowing and production stability

applications.heading: Plastics and Masterbatch Directions to Evaluate
applications.intro: Review each documented direction in the buyer's own formulation, processing and end-use conditions.

items.title: High-Concentration Masterbatch
items.body: Evaluate M-340 at the intended pigment loading and carrier-resin system. Confirm dispersion, color direction, processing behavior and downstream dilution performance under the actual masterbatch conditions.

items.title: High-Quality Films
items.body: Review M-340 in the intended film formulation and production line. Confirm dispersion, film appearance, processing stability and performance at the required thickness and operating conditions.

items.title: Silk and Wire Plastics
items.body: Include M-340 in testing for the source-listed silk and wire plastics direction. Confirm pigment dispersion, processing behavior, appearance and suitability in the buyer’s specific polymer and production process.

items.title: Injection Plastics
items.body: Evaluate M-340 in injection-moulded plastic formulations using the actual resin, additives, pigment loading, processing temperature and moulding conditions.

items.title: Moderate-Durability Plastics
items.body: Review M-340 for plastic applications whose qualification target includes the source-listed moderate-durability direction. Confirm the required service performance through end-use testing.

evaluation.heading: What to Evaluate in Your Plastics Formulation
evaluation.intro: Use the documented M-340 profile and technical index to frame buyer testing.

groups.heading: Dispersion and Appearance Review
items: Dispersibility at the intended pigment loading and mixing conditions
Bluish-undertone direction in the complete formulation
Film appearance and production stability where film processing applies

groups.heading: Heat and End-Use Qualification
items: High-temperature anti-yellowing direction at the intended processing temperature
Compatibility with the selected resin and additive package
Masterbatch, film, injection or wire/silk plastics processing conditions, as applicable
End-use durability target, destination requirements and sample-validation results

evaluation.disclaimer: These evaluation priorities identify what to check during buyer testing. They do not guarantee a fixed result in every polymer, process or end-use environment.
